task_source: Nykra 0.14.0 real repository modules with artificially introduced single regression per checkout; NOT externally reported issues

tasks.bug: The one-sided exact paired p-value undercounts the equality boundary, reporting zero when all discordant pairs improve. Restore inclusive tail probability and preserve empty-discordance behavior.
Maze task solvability incorrectly allows a route to cross blocked wall cells. Restore correct 4-neighbor reachability under rectangular bounds.
The bootstrap confidence interval uses an incorrect upper percentile, understating the upper bound. Preserve deterministic task-resampling and two-sided 95% percentile semantics.
The score validator began accepting nonfinite float inputs (NaN and infinities). Preserve support for finite int/float and reject booleans and invalid types.
Identifiers currently reject valid simple identifiers and accept invalid text containing spaces or prohibited punctuation. Preserve validation length and allowed syntax.

The discovery-only agent entries incorrectly claim autonomous candidate-generation capability, which must remain false until a native adapter is validated. Preserve all other vendor detection reporting.

strategy.baseline: After the first evaluated patch, independently regenerate the target function from specification using the same previous code and public failure feedback
strategy.nykra: After the first evaluated patch, revise the existing candidate function guided by the same feedback

evaluation: source function replacement in disposable git copy, public cases after every call, private cases only after best public-scored candidate is selected, re-grade from clean mutated checkout
comparison: small exploratory paired controlled model-generation policy comparison, not a production bugfix, not SWE-bench, not externally blind
security: Codex inference read-only, output structured JSON, host patches only an allowed top-level function in an isolated Git checkout; grader subprocess is NOT a hardened sandbox; no production code modification
